title: Fix lock mode race and TTL loss in Redis Lua scripts
description:
**Bug 1**: `core/infra/locks/redis_store.go:252` — Lua acquire script allows shared→exclusive mode switch mid-flight, violating lock contract.

**Bug 2**: `core/infra/locks/redis_store.go:289-297` — Release script: if PTTL returns -1 (no expiry), the SET without EX makes the lock permanent.

**Fix**: 
- Lua acquire: reject mode changes on existing locks
- Lua release: handle PTTL -1/-2 cases explicitly

**Files**: `core/infra/locks/redis_store.go`
definitionOfDone: Lock mode cannot be changed on an existing lock
PTTL edge cases (-1, -2) are handled in release script
Lua script unit tests cover both scenarios

implementationPlan.description:
Fix the Lua acquire script (lines 206-262) to reject mode changes on existing locks. At line 251, where `onlyOwner and count > 0` allows mode change to exclusive, add a check that the requested mode matches the current lock mode:

Replace lines 243-260 with:
```lua
-- Requesting exclusive on a shared lock
if count == 0 then
  return ""
end
if onlyOwner then
  -- Same owner holds all shares — allow upgrade to exclusive
  lock["mode"] = "exclusive"
  owners[owner] = (owners[owner] or 0) + 1
  lock["owners"] = owners
  lock["updated_at"] = now
  lock["expires_at"] = now + math.floor(ttl/1000)
  local encoded = cjson.encode(lock)
  redis.call("SET", key, encoded, "PX", ttl)
  return encoded
end
return ""
```
This preserves the single-owner upgrade path but prevents multi-owner mode changes.

Fix the Lua release script (lines 289-297) to handle PTTL edge cases. Replace:
```lua
local ttl = redis.call("PTTL", key)
if ttl > 0 then
  local encoded = cjson.encode(lock)
  redis.call("SET", key, encoded, "PX", ttl)
  return encoded
end
local encoded = cjson.encode(lock)
redis.call("SET", key, encoded)
return encoded
```
With:
```lua
local ttl = redis.call("PTTL", key)
local encoded = cjson.encode(lock)
if ttl > 0 then
  redis.call("SET", key, encoded, "PX", ttl)
elseif ttl == -1 then
  -- Key exists but has no expiry — this shouldn't happen, set a default
  redis.call("SET", key, encoded, "PX", 30000)
else
  -- Key doesn't exist (ttl == -2), shouldn't reach here after GET succeeded
  redis.call("SET", key, encoded, "PX", 30000)
end
return encoded
```
Run `go test ./core/infra/locks/...` to verify no regressions. Add test cases for mode-switch rejection and PTTL edge cases if not already covered.

reopenReason: DoD #3 not met + epic rail violation: no new tests were added (test file not modified). The PTTL edge case (-1 / no expiry) is not tested. Need a test that: (1) acquires a shared lock, (2) uses miniredis `mr.SetTTL(key, 0)` or PERSIST to remove TTL from the lock key, (3) calls Release for one owner, (4) verifies the key still has a TTL (safety 30s fallback was applied). The mode-switch scenario is already covered by the existing TestRedisStoreShared test, but PTTL is completely untested.
